description: Show what scope creep and a slow month do to one fixed-price package. Takes the cost base, the package price, its typical effort and direct cost, and optionally sales per month and a cash reserve. Returns margin and profit per sale at each scope creep level (default 10, 25 and 50 percent more effort on the same deliverables), the overrun at which the package earns nothing, the price that holds the target margin at the worst case, and the month view: a normal month, a slow month (default 40 percent fewer sales), a slow month with creep, break-even sales a month, and how many slow months the reserve covers. Deterministic arithmetic with the method explained.

delivery_hours_per_month.description: Hours the whole team can put into client work in a month, not counting sales and admin. Used to measure capacity and cost, never shown to clients.

monthly_fixed_costs.description: Overhead every month regardless of work: rent, software, insurance, vehicles, accounting.

monthly_owner_pay.description: What the owner needs to take home each month. It is treated as a cost, so profit is what is left after the owner is paid.

monthly_staff_cost.description: Salaried team cost per month, including payroll taxes. Default 0.

planned_utilization_pct.description: Share of delivery hours expected to be filled in a normal month. Default 80.

variable_cost_per_hour.description: Cost that rises with each delivery hour, such as subcontractor or crew wages. Default 0.

cash_reserve.description: Cash set aside for slow months.

effort_hours.description: Typical delivery effort for one sale of this package.

sales_per_month.description: Normal sales of this package per month. Enables the slow month view.

scope_creep_pct.description: Extra effort levels to test, in percent. Default 10, 25, 50.

slow_month_drop_pct.description: How far sales fall in a slow month, in percent. Default 40.

name: stress_test_package
title: Stress test a package
